text: Look at what a real client sees, not at what the files on disk say. make probe and the prober's 'err' field disagree with 'it worked yesterday'.
There are two TLS hops. After the edge handshake works, a 502 means the gateway cannot complete mTLS to the backend. make probe MESH=1.
Re-issue only what is broken, keep the keys, build fullchain = leaf + intermediate, then make apply instead of restarting anything.
